verdict.rationale: Expensify documents a conversational AI ('Ask Expensify AI' and the Concierge agent) that creates, categorizes, approves and rejects expenses, builds workspace rules in plain language, answers account questions, and auto-submits reports, so a policy-aware assistant exists. None of the cited material shows it doing the specific enforcement tasks in the story. The 2017 community claim that Concierge support replies were human-handled is old and too indirect to contradict the newer AI claims. Missing for 10: evidence of the AI chasing missing receipts, explaining declines to employees, answering 'can I expense this?' before spend, and independent hands-on corroboration of the conversational policy enforcement.
